summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit announcing a board meeting date. The board will meet on August 19, 2026 to discuss and approve unaudited results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with the results announcement to follow on August 20, 2026. The filing is a routine notice of a scheduled board meeting for quarterly earnings, not a special situation. No corporate action, transaction, or event triggering special-situation classification is involved. The filing includes standard boilerplate about the company's weighted voting rights structure and board composition. No deal terms are disclosed, and no special-situation category applies.
